design:
# THE CONFLUENT REGISTRY — maximal K-DMERGE instance (Mode C: Anchored Deterministic-Merge Admission Fabric)

## 0. Thesis
Mode A makes canonical state a PLACE — a kernel seat whose crash, seizure, or corruption is an event the design must survive. Mode B makes it a VOTE — a quorum whose liveness is hostage to connectivity and whose integrity has a collusion threshold. Mode C makes it a THEOREM: canonical state is the value of one pure, total, deterministic function — Merge — applied to a committed set of immutable, content-addressed, author-signed operations. The single logical serialization point required by frozen H4 is the merge function itself: an operation becomes canonical ONLY by passing the single decidable admission predicate K at its deterministic merge position, before canonicalization. Nobody executes admission authoritatively; everybody who evaluates it computes the same bits. The closure's own DIM-05 adjudication (CA P1-7) holds that this family QUALIFIES under frozen H4 — the deterministic merge is the one serialization point and admission precedes canonicalization — and that the K-CRDT elimination does NOT cover it (shipped CRDTs replicate-and-accept before any admission predicate runs; here nothing enters canon except through K at merge).

Three error classes are eliminated structurally rather than guarded (supreme-law rule 2):
1. **Crash-recovery ordering**: canonical state is a cache; authoritative storage holds only immutable content-addressed operations; the recovery procedure IS the everyday merge function. WAL-replay ordering, torn multi-record transactions, and recovery idempotence cease to exist as reasoning obligations.
2. **Serialization-point Byzantine failure**: a mathematical function has no operator. Forging an admission outcome requires breaking the hash/signature primitives or changing K's genesis-committed code identity — there is no collusion threshold above which admission integrity fails.
3. **Availability coupling**: no admission-relevant work waits on a seat or a quorum; only FINALITY waits on anchoring, and an overdue anchor is a typed, accountable, fail-closed stall, never a hang.

## 1. Objects — the entire ontology is ONE object kind
- **Operation** op = {author-capability-id, author-seq n, prev = H(author's op n−1), causal-deps = set of H(op) heads observed at creation, typed payload, signature}. Identity = H(op) (content-addressed). Bodies committed as H(salt‖body) per leaf: erasure-compatible per the frozen AX-07 ceiling — an erasure certificate destroys body+salt while the chain, inclusion proofs, and a typed ERASED marker survive; silent deletion is inexpressible.
- **Payload types**: source-capture records (AX-04 dual digests, attested-channel receipts), rulebase admissions, derivation certificates, plan objects, matter transitions, reflective episodes, legal-order profiles (AX-22), floor-ratchet upgrade ops (AX-20), external-effect intent/outcome journal ops (AX-11), adversarial findings and kill matrices (AX-10), and ANCHOR ops.
- **ANCHOR ops are ordinary ops** authored under a distinguished registrar capability: payload = {epoch e, Merkle root over the closed op set O_e = causal closure of the declared heads, prev-anchor id, k-of-n witness cosignatures, external time brackets (Roughtime-class / eIDAS-TSA per the AX-17 ceiling)}. K admits an anchor only if the machine-checked subset condition O_{e−1} ⊆ O_e holds, the witness cosignature quorum verifies, and the registrar author chain is unequivocal. Anchors-as-ops preserves the class signature exactly — canonical state remains a pure function of the committed op set, with anchors inside that set — and keeps ONE object kind, ONE admission predicate, ONE serialization function (one seat per concept).

## 2. The merge function — the serialization point
Total deterministic order on any anchored set: (epoch of first anchoring, deterministic topological order of the causal DAG within the epoch, H(op) tie-break). Epoch stratification yields **PREFIX STABILITY**: sort(O_{e−1}) is a literal prefix of sort(O_e); once anchored, an op's merge position is frozen forever, so canonical history is gapless and monotone (AX-08 clause (a)) as a consequence of the subset check in K — a theorem, machine-enforced at anchor admission. Canonical state S_e = fold(K, S_genesis, sort(O_e)). K(state, op) is total, pure, decidable: capability/delegation-chain recomputation from the hash-committed genesis anchor, type/contract checks, footprint-conflict checks, and the full symbolic content battery (§5). ADMIT ⇒ the op's effect enters state; every other outcome ⇒ typed REFUSAL(reason) — a DERIVED fact: every evaluator of (O_e, K) recomputes the identical refusal set, so refusals can be neither lost nor forged. Refusal-hood as theorem is strictly stronger than H4's "signed durable refusal record": the record is the committed set itself.
- **Load-bearing design commitment, named**: the unstratified variant (one global hash/causal order over the whole set) is REJECTED — a late-arriving op could sort before anchored ops and retroactively rewrite canonical history, violating gapless-monotone history and H6. Epoch stratification is the exact mechanism that reconciles convergent replication with H4/H6 monotone canonical history. Between anchors, all derived state is typed PROVISIONAL and is never served as canonical (H2); PROVISIONAL never silently upgrades.
- **Author equivocation** (two ops with the same (author, n)): a deterministic rule of K — both ops typed EQUIVOCATION-REFUSED, the author capability frozen from n forward, and the pair is itself an attributable fraud proof. Byzantine proposers in ANY number cannot corrupt canon: validity is objective (admission at merge) and dissemination integrity is content-addressed (Kleppmann–Howard Byzantine-eventual-consistency class results for hash-DAG replication among arbitrary numbers of Byzantine peers).

## 3. Topology, trust, degradation
- **Replicas**: any capability holder; fully offline-capable; sync the op DAG over ANY untrusted transport — content addressing puts the entire distribution layer OUTSIDE the TCB (contrast Mode B, where the consensus protocol is the heart of the TCB).
- **Registrar**: a nano-authority that can ONLY (i) equivocate epochs — attributable (two signed anchors at one epoch), prevented at anchor grain by the witness cosignature requirement inside K plus transparency-log publication (the same witness resource kind the frozen AX-07(c)/AX-08(b)/AX-12 clauses name); or (ii) censor/delay ops — detectable by the op's author (absent inclusion proof against the anchor root), escalated as a typed CENSORSHIP-CLAIM op, bounded by threshold/rotating registrar keys. The registrar can NEVER forge an admission, alter content, or reorder within an epoch: those are theorems of committed bytes. Registrar unavailability stalls finality as a typed accountable state; all pre-finality work continues.
- **Degradation ladder (honest)**: content-and-admission integrity — threshold-free (falls only with the hash/signature primitives); membership/epoch integrity — split-view-resistant at witness quorum, fork-consistent below it (exactly the frozen caps); finality liveness — registrar+witness availability at anchor cadence; local work liveness — unconditional under total partition. Contrast: Mode B loses admission integrity itself at f+1 collusion; Mode A loses it at one seat compromise; Mode C's admission integrity has no collusion threshold at all, while its real-time non-equivocation between anchors is weaker than Mode B's quorum-intersection prevention — stated, not hidden.

## 4. Serving discipline
An answer is served CANONICAL only with a certificate {anchor id, Merkle inclusion proofs for every op in its support, the derivation object}; any third party re-verifies fully offline from genesis + anchor chain + op bytes with zero producer trust (H8). PROVISIONAL and UNKNOWN are distinct served types (H2).

## 5. Symbolic content core — pinned (the K-TLOG re-steelman lesson applied)
The strongest surviving core runs INSIDE K and as pure views of S_e: certified grounded-defeasible labeller with the certified ideal/sceptical-preferred rung under a committed AX-17 cost budget (AX-01); grammar-total proof-carrying citation resolution with receipt chains and bitemporal validity (AX-05); typed bitemporal amendment event calculus with t_knowledge = anchoring epoch (AX-08); the four-verdict typed-UNKNOWN battery with certified stability certificates (AX-09); the floor-vector ratchet as a K conjunct on upgrade ops (AX-20); profile-parametric noninterference (AX-22). None of this is class-specific; the class contributes the coordination/durability/audit spine these cores ride on.

## 6. Recovery — the class's signature axis
Authoritative storage = append-only content-addressed op store (fsync of file AND directory per the frozen AX-15 ceiling; an op counts DURABLE only after read-back hash verification — fail-closed read-back realized natively). Canonical state, indexes, and checkpoints are caches. Crash at any instant: a torn append fails its content-hash check and equals "never durable"; no other crash state is expressible. Recovery = filter(hash-valid) ∘ re-merge, cost Θ(op tail since the last canonical checkpoint) — matching the frozen bounded-recovery clause — and the recovery procedure is the merge function itself, the same code exercised on every read, whose determinism is the substrate property with EXISTING offline-re-checkable mechanizations: the Isabelle/HOL strong-eventual-consistency framework (Gomes–Kleppmann–Mulligan–Beresford, OOPSLA 2017), the OpSets mechanization of deterministic op-set interpretation (canonical state as a pure function of a totally ordered op set — this class's exact formal shape), and Perennial/GoJournal-class crash-Hoare artifacts for the append-store substrate. The injected-crash test surface collapses to ONE crash class (content-addressed blob append) instead of one per transition class. A within-model consequence stated honestly as attainment, not exceed: recovery yields Merge of the maximal hash-valid causally-closed durable SUBSET — a corrupted blob costs only itself and its causal dependents, never forcing truncation of causally independent later material, while every barrier-acknowledged op survives as the frozen clause requires.

## 7. External effects
Per the frozen AX-11 clause (ii): intent op → external call under idempotency key → outcome op; the irrevocable external act is structurally excluded from the atomic section; unknowable outcomes park as typed UNKNOWN. Internal partial application is inexpressible — state is derived, never mutated.

## 8. TCB and build reality
TCB: Merge + K + hash + signature verification + the store's append/read path + the proof-checker kernel. No consensus protocol, no network stack, no scheduler. This is the smallest trusted surface in the field. NOTHING IS BUILT: no shipped member instantiates this class (the closure's own DIM-05 finding); every EXECUTING_WITNESS cell is empty by honesty; design entailments lean only on structure plus existing offline-re-checkable substrate-class mechanizations, and every rung requiring our own proof or execution artifacts is typed WOULD_NEED_BUILD.

## 9. Position on obligation (b)
This design is the constructive third branch of the round-1 Mode A × Mode B binary, which the completeness critique refuted as a framing: the serialization point realized as a pure function has a failure algebra neither mode shares (no seat to seize, no quorum to lose; admission integrity threshold-free; the residual authority — membership attestation — is strictly weaker than either mode's writer). Under CEILING-BAR, pinning Mode A or B now owes a frozen impossibility-under-chosen-model note against these rungs; the anticipated reduction attack ("the registrar is just Mode A's seat again") fails on the trust algebra: Mode A's seat holds admission+order+membership authority; the registrar holds membership only, and lies about it are attributable and witness-prevented at anchor grain.

axis_profile.mechanism: Pinned certified grounded-defeasible labeller plus the certified ideal/sceptical-preferred rung via proof-logging exhaustive-extension enumeration under a committed AX-17 cost budget, evaluated inside K at merge, so every conclusion is a theorem of (O_e, K) carrying an offline-recheckable certificate. Grounded rung is standard engineering; the certified-enumeration certifier is the build gap — the same gap as the entire field.

Plans are admitted ops; K rejects at merge every defect in the decidable class (cycles, produces/consumes type mismatch, unreachable goal, orphan stage, ambiguous order); the deterministic total order supplies the unique schedule. R5 (verified plan calculus with offline proofs) not claimed — those proofs are build artifacts.

The delta rule's requirement — the exclusion proof itself independently re-checkable — is met by existing substrate-class mechanizations replayable today: the Isabelle/HOL SEC framework (Gomes et al. OOPSLA 2017) and OpSets' mechanized deterministic op-set interpretation, which is this class's exact formal shape (canonical state = pure function of a totally ordered op set). Deadlock excluded structurally (no locks — a fold), lost-update excluded (nothing is ever overwritten; all ops retained and deterministically ordered), unarbitrated conflict excluded (every conflict reaches K deterministically); every arbitration outcome is a replayable theorem of the committed set. Named discharge per the r2 regime: recorded replay of the Isabelle artifacts into the tournament evidence set; mechanizing the admission-fold composition is the declared AX-21 residue — the same residue shape round 1 processed for K-BFT's AX-03.

Capture ops carry the AX-04 ceiling's admissible origin forms (publisher signature / witness corroboration / attested-channel receipt) with dual digests and deterministic-extraction byte-equality; selection is by exact committed identifier only; membership via Merkle inclusion against the anchor root; the grounding derivation is offline re-verifiable against the frozen corpus with zero producer trust. Executed-evidence rider (structural bypass-impossibility demonstration) named as the discharge artifact.

Grammar-total coverage-gated recognizer over declared L(G) runs inside K; every citation resolves through a verified receipt chain (owner-key pinning, delegation validity at genTime, revocation, bitemporal validity at the citation's reference time) to a committed authority record; out-of-grammar citation-like strings are typed UNKNOWN-CITATION that never upgrades (H2); coverage is total because admission is the only path into canon.

Lineage is native: an artifact exists in S_e only as the value of the committed op DAG, so an artifact without complete lineage is inexpressible, not merely inadmissible; per-step (input-hash, transformation-id, output-hash) commitments sit under domain-separated Merkle roots inside anchors; a third party re-derives every artifact by re-merge and byte-compares with zero producer trust.

Matter memory is a derived view of S_e; every write is an admitted op — all-or-nothing by derivation, provenance-complete by the op schema; reflective performance episodes are ops under the same K; salted per-leaf commitments give verifiable erasure with typed certificates per the frozen ceiling; recall is a pure function of the anchored prefix; fork detection sits exactly at the frozen witness-lifted cap for the membership residue.

t_knowledge = first-anchoring epoch (witness-cosigned, externally time-bracketed); t_legal from typed amendment events under the committed event calculus; epoch-stratified prefix stability makes gapless monotone history a machine-checked consequence of the anchor subset condition in K; every answer certified and replayable at its (t_legal, e) pair. Executed-evidence rider (re-runnable past-time evaluation witness) named as discharge.

Four-verdict battery (PASS / FAIL-with-counter-certificate / STABLE-over-UNKNOWNs with certified invariance / typed UNKNOWN from the closed cause enumeration) emitted as ops; frontier certificates are theorems of (O_e, K). The stability certifier, the closed unknowability-cause enumeration, and the census tooling are unbuilt — the field-wide gap.

Operational axis — design cannot entail it (round-1 ruling accepted). Mechanism when built: mutation-kill matrices, counter-design findings, and refutations are ops; an OPEN finding is a derived blocking predicate in K on anchor admission, so release-with-open-finding is structurally impossible (fail-closed); escalation is a typed op to the accountable human authority.

Anchoring is the certificate-carrying monotonic commit sequence; internal partial application is structurally inexpressible because state is derived, never mutated; external effects follow the frozen clause-(ii) ceiling verbatim — intent/outcome journal ops, idempotency keys, irrevocable acts excluded from the atomic section, unknowable outcomes typed UNKNOWN.

Authorization validity is offline-decidable by delegation-chain recomputation from genesis inside K; every transition records principal, basis, and certificate (R4 structurally entailed); the R5 differentiator — machine-checked verification of the authority model itself — is a build; the Cedar-in-Lean substrate artifact shortens but does not close the gap, since this design's authority-model theorems are unwritten.

The class's defining property: a verifier holding genesis + anchor chain + op bytes re-merges the entire history and recompute-and-compares every state root, every refusal, and every answer certificate fully offline with zero producer trust; auditability terminates at the commitment boundary exactly as the frozen ceiling states. Named discharge per the replay rider: a replay demonstration covering one decision from every trusted decision class.

Trusted decisions are pure functions of the committed closure by construction: logical clock = epoch, no wall-clock/RNG/IO in Merge or K, and the merge schedule is itself deterministic data — the parallel-merge-schedule nondeterminism source named by the frozen ceiling is eliminated rather than reified. R5 machine-verified purity is a build; divergence-free perturbed-replay demonstration named as the R4 discharge artifact.

Recovery = filter(hash-valid) ∘ re-merge with pre-declared bound Θ(tail since last checkpoint); the recovery procedure is the merge function itself — no special-purpose crash code exists — so 'the recovery procedure itself verified' inherits the existing substrate mechanizations (Isabelle SEC/OpSets for merge determinism; Perennial/GoJournal crash-Hoare class for the append store), and the injected-crash surface collapses to a single crash class (content-addressed blob append, torn write = fail-closed non-durability). Typed WOULD_NEED_BUILD because the frozen delta rule demands injected-crash execution evidence regardless of substrate proofs; under the round-2 substrate-proof uniformity ruling (completeness critique item iii, Velisarios standard) this cell re-adjudicates toward design entailment with a named replay discharge. This is the field's only structurally-collapsed AX-15 story; field max today is R4 with no verified recovery procedure anywhere.

Declared operating model: partitionable network, offline-capable replicas, registrar and witness quorum reachable at anchor cadence, finite committed inputs. Merge/K termination is structural (a fold of total decidable functions over a finite set); dissemination liveness has Byzantine-eventual-consistency-class results; every wait is typed — an overdue anchor is a derived, externally-time-bracketed, accountable stall, and the system blocks fail-closed, never hangs. Unique regime property recorded in notes: all pre-finality work retains bounded-termination liveness under total partition. R5's offline-recheckable liveness proof corpus is a build.

complexity_class declared per frozen workload class: exact recomputable abstract cost certificates from deterministic execution (fold cost is a theorem of the committed set); serve/read latency class = local recomputation against the held canonical anchor — no quorum round, no remote seat on the read path; finality latency class = anchor cadence, declared honestly as the class's trade (a class below Mode A's fsync-commit immediacy); fail-closed cost-budget gates in K.

Declared classes: admission work parallelizes per the work-span law over disjoint-footprint K checks; anchoring natively realizes the frozen ceiling's batched amortized serialization floor (per-epoch batching, O(1) amortized hashing per op, O(log n) proof material); memoized fold checkpoints reduce re-verification of unchanged anchored prefixes to one digest comparison per cached unit plus the delta. R4 machine-checked scaling bounds are unbuilt (field-wide gap, max R3 everywhere).

The served object IS the derivation: decision and explanation are the same theorem of (O_e, K), so divergence is structurally impossible; effect-execution and trace-emission are the same event — the fold step — at the one seat, satisfying the frozen ceiling's rung 1 with the one-gate-one-head constraint (round-1 obligation (d)) holding by construction, since serialization point, kernel predicate, and commitment root are one artifact. Rung 2 whole-perimeter verification is the AX-21 build; independent trace-vs-explanation comparison named as the rider discharge.

Upgrade ops (including upgrades of Merge/K code identity) carry floor recomputation from the previous release's census, pointwise non-regression, floor-set growth, and preservation-proof re-checks as K conjuncts evaluated identically by every evaluator; a step failing any conjunct is a derived refusal. The preservation-proof corpus does not exist — the field-wide gap.

The core invariant class — canonical-state determinism over committed op sets — has an existing, reusable mechanization route: the Isabelle SEC framework was built to prove exactly this property class and OpSets is its worked instance, making this the field's shortest path to R3. But this design's own theorems (admission-fold determinism, epoch-stratified prefix stability, H4/H5/H6 formalizations) are unwritten, and round 1 deflated analogous substrate-only R3 claims to R2 — so the honest type is build-gated, with the enumerated TCB (Merge, K, hash, signatures, store path, proof-checker kernel; no consensus or network stack) as the design's structural contribution.

Profile-parametric noninterference: legal-order profiles (article ranges, publisher keys, citation grammar, deontic lexicon, calendar) are committed ops; Merge and K contain no order-specific logic; an order without a well-formed committed profile yields typed UNKNOWN. R4 requires the two-structurally-distinct-order instantiation that exists nowhere in the field.

exceed_claims.claim: Scoped correction of the frozen relativity note, not of the invariant frontier (the deterministic-outcome frontier and Brent bound are conceded verbatim). The note states 'the choice between physical single-writer and replicated-total-order realizations of the serialization point is a declared-resource choice' — an exhaustive binary. The closure's own DIM-05 grammar (CA P1-7) contains, and this design instantiates, a third realization: the serialization point as a pure function over a committed set, where admission, order, and state are theorems of committed bytes and the only residual authority is set-membership attestation. Its failure algebra is shared by neither named realization: a physical seat can be seized (admission+order+membership authority lost at one compromise); a quorum loses admission integrity at f+1 collusion; a function can be neither seized nor colluded — admission and order integrity are threshold-free, leaving membership as the entire attack surface. Anticipated reduction 'the anchor registrar is a physical single writer, so this is Mode A factored' is answered in the design (§9): factoring is exactly the point — the frozen note treats seat-trust as an indivisible unit, and this realization proves the serialization point's trust decomposes, with the writer-role residue strictly smaller than either named realization requires. Consequence claimed: the round-1 obligation (b) binary framing is refuted constructively; under CEILING-BAR, pinning Mode A or Mode B owes a frozen impossibility-under-chosen-model note against Mode C's rungs, which cannot be written from the binary as stated.

Narrow claim against the RESOURCE_BOUNDED equivocation clause only; every ABSOLUTE clause (decidable admission, genesis anchor, fail-closed totality, process-not-substance) is attained, not contested, and the fresh-verifier wholesale-replacement bound is conceded. The frozen clause quantifies over an undifferentiated view-space: 'a lying single writer can maintain divergent views', capped at fork consistency, liftable by witness quorum to split-view resistance. This design proves the attainable cap is strictly tighter at the same witness resource kind: because order-given-membership and admission-given-set are deterministic theorems of committed bytes under the genesis-committed K, divergent views can differ ONLY in membership/epoch attestation — order-equivocation and admission-equivocation are eliminated as classes, for any collusion level, forever. A lying serialization authority in Mode A can serve two internally-valid canonical histories from one op population by ordering it twice; here that is structurally impossible — forking requires forking the committed set itself, which is the attributable, witness-prevented residue. The frozen supremum ('witness quorum lifts the cap to split-view resistance') therefore understates the attainable guarantee: split-view resistance over a membership-only equivocation surface is strictly stronger than split-view resistance over the full view-space the clause quantifies over, and — unlike K-BFT's refuted prevention claim — this shrinkage does not degrade above any collusion threshold, because it is not enforced by any party.

notes: HONESTY LEDGER. (1) Zero EXECUTING_WITNESS cells — asserted deliberately: the closure's own DIM-05 finding is that no shipped member instantiates this family; any executing-witness claim here would be fabrication. Profile: 15 DESIGN_ENTAILMENT / 7 WOULD_NEED_BUILD (AX-01, 09, 10, 12, 15, 20, 21), with the r2 regime's executed-evidence riders (AX-03 R4+, AX-04 R3+, AX-08 R3+, AX-10, AX-13, AX-14 R4+, AX-15 R4+, AX-19 R3+) anticipated by naming the discharge artifact inside each affected mechanism — the DESIGN_ENTAILMENT entries on rider axes are claims of structural entailment awaiting CONDITIONAL_ON_NAMED_BUILD retyping, not AT_CEILING claims. (2) AX-15 evidence-kind contingency, stated once and bindingly: typed WOULD_NEED_BUILD under the frozen delta rule's injected-crash requirement even though the substrate-class mechanized artifacts exist (Isabelle SEC / OpSets / Perennial class); if the round-2 substrate-proof uniformity ruling (completeness critique item iii) grounds rungs on existing substrate-class mechanizations — the standard already applied once for K-BFT's AX-03 — this cell re-adjudicates and K-DMERGE holds the field's only R5-path AX-15 story; if the ruling goes the other way, K-BFT's AX-03 falls to the same standard. Either ruling leaves K-DMERGE's AX-15 the only design whose recovery procedure is its already-mechanized everyday read path. (3) Distinctness from the K-CRDT elimination, explicit: shipped CRDTs are admission-after-acceptance and were eliminated under frozen H4; here nothing is accepted into canon except through K at the deterministic merge — admission precedes canonicalization at the one serialization point, exactly the surviving family's definition. The design captures K-CRDT's credited superior rungs (offline operation; tamper-evidence without quorum) inside U_T instead of leaving them to a D_T comparison member. (4) Load-bearing commitments that a round-2 adversary should attack first: (a) epoch-stratified merge order — the unstratified variant is rejected in-text because it permits retroactive canonical rewrite; kill the stratification and the class dies on AX-08; (b) anchors-as-ops with the O_{e−1} ⊆ O_e conjunct in K — this is what makes gapless monotone history a theorem; (c) the PROVISIONAL/CANONICAL type split — serving provisional state as canonical would breach H2/H4 and the serving discipline is the guard; (d) registrar-holds-no-admission-authority — if any admission decision leaks into the anchor act, the design collapses into Mode A and exceed claim AX-03 is void. (5) Unique field cells filed as COMPARISON NOTES, deliberately NOT as exceed claims (they concern regimes the frozen declared models exclude, and round 1 refuted 27/27 exceeds partly on such scope grounds): (i) AX-16 partition regime — under arbitrary partition all pre-finality institutional work keeps bounded-termination liveness with H4/H5 intact while Mode B provably halts (quorum) and Mode A's seat is an availability point; only finality stalls, typed; a joint {partition-liveness, H4, H5} cell neither pinned mode occupies — recommend a taxonomy/scope note to the freeze authority, since the frozen AX-16 ceiling's single-node model makes the field blind to this regime; (ii) multi-replica durability composes by set-union re-sync without consensus latency — kept OUT of the AX-15 exceed claim because the frozen ceiling names replication as an outside-model resource and K-BFT's analogous exceed was refuted verbatim on that clause; (iii) TCB minimality — no consensus protocol, network stack, or scheduler in the trusted surface; the distribution layer is untrusted by content addressing. (6) Weakest cells, named: finality latency class (anchor cadence — AX-17's declared trade); real-time non-equivocation between anchors is detection-class, weaker than Mode B's quorum-intersection prevention (conceded inside the AX-12 exceed claim's scope); registrar censorship is detectable-and-escalatable, not preventable, bounded by threshold/rotating keys; AX-21 sits at unwritten-proof status like the whole field. (7) Serves round-2 mandate items (i) and (b): this profile is the 10th-profile filing the completeness critic showed obligation (b) cannot close without; the two exceed claims are scoped to survive the recorded refutation patterns (no reliance on outside-model resources; invariant frontiers conceded; reduction attacks pre-answered).
